---
title: Code Cell Through Include
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      # The included `_cell.qmd` carries a `{python}` cell, so jupyter
      # resolves as the owning engine. Without a jupyter runtime the
      # render is a loud P2-12 error; gate the fixture on it.
      requires: jupyter
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["code-marker-from-child"]
---
